purpose: Corrected primary EP8 topology: one node with eight GPUs; V3/V4 inference-only CUDA Graph comparison at 1620 MHz

measurement.timing: CUDA event around complete graph replay batch
measurement.evidence: Reversed-order independent-process sessions; not per-iteration switching in one process
measurement.reported_p50: Per sample rank maximum, pool 40 samples from both sessions of each version, select sorted index 19 (lower p50)
measurement.rank_sync: NCCL rank barrier outside each timed sample
measurement.pool_capacity: Separate pool for each case, token capacity matches the case
measurement.excluded: The two-node 2x4 EP8 results do not represent single-node EP8; historical unlocked runs are not pooled here

v3.selection: Same frozen V3 Qwen GEMM/resource profile as the multi-node comparison, executing its local-only specialization; no single-node per-length retuning

v4.selection: Final static single-node specialization with the 2026-09-22 frozen profile

conclusion: Single-node V4 improves 1/64-token decode but regresses 8192/20480-token prefill against this V3 profile; configuration and implementation comparison, not isolated scheduler attribution
